newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Marriott invests 25 pct of Philippine resort.
newsitem.headline: Marriott invests 25 pct of Philippine resort.

text.p: Marriott International Inc has taken a 25 percent equity stake in a Philippine resort in central Cebu province, financial adviser All AsiaCapital and Trust Corp said on Sunday.
All AsiaCapital said in a statement Marriott will invest $4.8 million for the construction of the 325-room Mactan Island Marriott Resort.
Marriott has also been tapped to manage the hotel which is part of Porto Bello Cove Resort, an integrated leisure estate.
Other investors are Filipino real estate firm LuDo and LuYm Development Corp and All AsiaProperties Corp, a subsidiary of All AsiaCapital.
